worker_policy: all logical processors visible to the frozen job
run_concurrency: one optimization process at a time; parallelism is inside each optimization
resume_policy: reuse only a front and summary pair that passes validate_pbea_formal_run.py

result_contract.front: atomic JSON containing every final nondominated objective triple and exact layout
result_contract.summary: atomic one-line JSON containing identity, physical FES, nondominated count, and separated timings
result_contract.environment: campaign receipt records HEAD, clean-worktree state, compiler, CMake, lscpu, affinity, nproc, and binary SHA-256
result_contract.final_manifest: sorted per-file SHA-256 ledger and completeness counts
